description: This file defines the ReadableShippingSummaryPopulator class, which extends AbstractDataPopulator to convert ShippingSummary objects into ReadableShippingSummary objects, including setting shipping and handling details with the help of PricingService.

classes.name: ReadableShippingSummaryPopulator
classes.description: A populator class that converts ShippingSummary entities into ReadableShippingSummary DTOs, enriching them with display amounts for shipping and handling using PricingService.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts a ShippingSummary object into a ReadableShippingSummary, setting various shipping and tax details, with error handling via ConversionException.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ReadableShippingSummary.

methods.name: getPricingService
methods.description: Returns the PricingService instance used in this populator.

methods.name: setPricingService
methods.description: Sets the PricingService dependency for this populator.
